adjudication_reasoning: MFAFNet is evaluated on Cityscapes and CamVid urban driving datasets (75.9%/69.9% mIoU at 60/82.6 FPS), with no agricultural crop/weed content. It is a generic real-time segmentation architecture for mobile/drone/autonomous-driving scenes, outside the crop/weed domain, so EXC-03 applies.

ESFCNet is validated on UAVid and UDD6 urban land-cover UAV datasets (mIoU 69.5%/78.3%), which are generic urban aerial segmentation benchmarks, not agricultural crop/weed imagery. No crop or weed agronomy is addressed, so EXC-03 governs.

This is cooperative USV-UAV trajectory planning where the UAV provides obstacle semantic segmentation for a marine surface vessel under NMPC hull-constraint control. The domain is marine/robotic navigation, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 excludes it.

This is an uncertainty-aware volumetric-semantic exploration and mapping framework for autonomous aerial shipyard inspection using DCNNs, with simulations in a shipyard setting. The domain is industrial inspection/exploration, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 excludes it.

CEFD is a communication-efficient federated-distillation framework for post-flash-flood risk and severity assessment with UAV swarms, evaluated on the LSD dataset (mIoU 0.62). Flood-disaster assessment is outside the crop/weed agronomy domain, so EXC-03 applies.

3D-ARSS is an attention-based 3D semantic segmentation of Velodyne LiDAR point clouds on edge for unmanned ground/aerial vehicles, evaluated on SemanticKITTI and NuScenes (autonomous driving). It is a LiDAR point-cloud modality outside aerial agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-01 and EXC-03 apply.

DAS-Net performs lightweight pixel-level segmentation of visible-light and infrared imagery for anti-UAV surveillance and tracking (mIoU 0.678, 26 FPS on Jetson AGX Orin). Although it reports strong edge metrics, the domain is UAV security/surveillance, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.

A U-Net with dilated convolution performs pixel-wise semantic segmentation to detect and count lizards from summer-grass drone imagery (accuracy 0.9863). The target is animal/ecology detection on grass, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 excludes it.

DynDarkSLAM is a YOLOv5/GAN-enhanced visual SLAM system for low-light localization and tracking for autonomous drone patrols, evaluated on trajectory error. It is a SLAM/localization domain paper, not crop/weed segmentation, so EXC-03 applies.

This work fuses vision and laser SLAM with DeepLabv3+ semantic segmentation for electric power-line inspection by UAVs. The domain is power-infrastructure inspection, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 excludes it.

OI-3DTM combines monocular depth, semantic segmentation, and 3D reconstruction for occlusion-aware traversability mapping in urban UAV navigation, evaluated on depth and UAV-LADIS datasets. The domain is urban navigation/mapping, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

This lightweight boundary/context-aware network performs real-time road semantic segmentation of UAV images (IoU 85.86%, 111 FPS) for security inspection and disaster rescue reconnaissance. Road-reconnaissance is outside the crop/weed agronomy domain, so EXC-03 applies.

ARV fuses DeepLabv3++ segmentation, YOLOv8 detection, and ViT classification on ISPRS Potsdam, VEDAI, and UAVid generic aerial benchmarks (97-98% accuracy). These are general urban aerial recognition datasets, with no crop/weed agronomy content, so EXC-03 applies.

Despite the UAV crop/weed context, this maize/weed identification method relies on shape features, threshold skeleton clustering, and multivariate regression (weed-removal accuracy >97%), explicitly not deep learning with learned segmentation features. As an exclusively classical image-analysis method it falls under EXC-04.

UAV-FAENet is a lightweight frequency-aware segmentation network evaluated on UAVid, UDD6, and DroneDeploy urban land-cover UAV datasets (mIoU 68.84/80.11/70.26%). These are generic urban/aerial benchmarks without agricultural crop/weed semantics, so EXC-03 applies.

An improved Mask-R-CNN/YOLOv9-Seg instance-segmentation method assesses damaged buildings from post-earthquake UAV images (mAPbbox50/mAPseg50). The domain is post-disaster structural damage, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.

The edge-AI study compares Hailo-8 Raspberry Pi vs Jetson AGX Orin for semantic segmentation of airport runway/taxiway markings and AGL lamps on a custom Poznań-Ławica dataset. The domain is airport/aviation infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A CNN performs semantic segmentation to diagnose corrosion on helicopter components for structural health monitoring. The domain is infrastructure/material integrity, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 excludes it.

SegNet detects villages in Google Earth satellite images (98% accuracy) for no-fly/open-zone geo-fencing. It uses satellite imagery (not UAV) and targets village/geo-fencing, so both EXC-01 and EXC-03 apply.

USVS-Net segments feasible domains and surface obstacles for unmanned surface vessel navigation (mIoU 81.71%, USV-DATA). The domain is marine vessel navigation, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.

DINOsegNext maps invasive Spartina alterniflora marsh plants from UAV imagery (IoU 0.742, F1 0.852, 8.5ms). Although vegetation with edge latency, the domain is coastal conservation of a marsh invasive species, not agricultural crop/weed management, so EXC-03 applies.

The study compares YOLOv8 vs U-Net for railway track crack detection/segmentation using a DJI Matrice 300 RTK UAV. The domain is railway infrastructure inspection, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.
Four FCN models are compared for forest-fire flame segmentation from UAV remote-sensing images (mPA/mIoU). The domain is forest-fire monitoring, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.

An anti-UAV semantic segmentation dataset (605,045 IR/visible UAV images) with lightweight real-time localization model supports small-target surveillance. The domain is UAV security/surveillance, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A lightweight U-Net+MobileNetV2 runs real-time low-power semantic segmentation on a RISC-V/FPGA platform (mIoU ~0.2, 70% acc, 3-5x FPGA latency reduction). It reports strong INC-03 edge metrics but the domain is generic drone perception, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.

CPP-ALA is a coverage-path-planning algorithm with deep-learning defect detection for UAV monitoring of solar power plants (97.8% defect accuracy). The domain is renewable-energy infrastructure inspection, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Aerial road-traffic vehicle detection and tracking uses FCN segmentation plus DeepSORT/RetinaNet on the VAID dataset (detection 95%, tracking 91%). The domain is urban traffic monitoring, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.

M-FasterSeg is a NAS-based real-time semantic segmentation network validated on the Cityscapes urban dataset (69.8% mIoU, 48/s). The domain is autonomous-driving/urban scenes, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.

RSNet segments rail/gage-inside/background regions of gross railroad aerial UAV images (RSSD, dice 0.973, jaccard 0.94). The domain is railway infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.
CDD-Net (DenseNet+ASPP+PointRend) extracts rural residential land from VHR UAV images (F1 92.62%, Dice 0.8359). The domain is rural land-use planning, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

OAVid is a benchmark of 824 oblique UAV images with 8 generic semantic classes, analyzed with DeepLabV3/SegFormer/SAM2-UNet. It is a general oblique-aerial dataset without crop/weed agricultural semantics, so EXC-03 applies.

M2H is a multi-task monocular perception model (segmentation/depth/edge) evaluated on NYUDv2, Hypersim, and Cityscapes. It is a general-purpose spatial-perception model without agricultural crop/weed content, so EXC-03 applies.

The work targets lightweight real-time semantic segmentation of UAV traffic videos with siamese-network keyframe recognition; no abstract is available. The stated traffic domain is outside crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.
MSDA-Net performs sub-millimeter bridge crack measurement from UAV imagery (mIoU 90.82% on DeepCrack). The domain is civil/bridge infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A binocular-visual FCN performs crack detection/measurement for concrete bridge components (precision 83.85%, recall 85.74%). The domain is civil/structural inspection, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

The system produces real-time ortho and semantic maps for disaster management and first responders using an IMU and segmentation network. The domain is disaster-management, not crop/weed agriculture, so EXC-03 applies.

A lightweight BiSeNet variant segments high-resolution UAV aerial images on Potsdam and Vaihingen urban land-cover datasets (mIoU 81.35%/71.82%). These are urban remote-sensing benchmarks, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A UAV actively finds targets using point-cloud semantic segmentation and path planning for power transmission line fine inspection. The domain is power-infrastructure inspection, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A three-stage framework extracts highway lanes from UAV imagery using an enhanced STDC segmentation network (F1 94.11%, IoU 93.84%). The domain is highway/transportation infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

An onboard edge-AI framework (U-Net-like, STDC) segments natural mountain landscape components such as vegetation, snow, glaciers, and avalanches (17-29 FPS, mIoU 0.79 on Jetson/Coral). CARLA2Real is a tool to reduce the sim2real gap for CARLA autonomous-driving data (Cityscapes/KITTI/Mapillary), evaluated for feature extraction and semantic segmentation. The domain is autonomous-driving simulation, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

3DGS reconstruction plus RandLA-Net segments equipment point clouds for power transmission/transformation projects (mIoU 84.2%). The domain is power-infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Knowledge-distilled SegFormer predicts safe landing zones for a Seismic Acquisition Drone (95.37% acc, 179 FPS). Although INC-03 edge metrics are central, the domain is landing-zone/land navigation for seismic acquisition, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.

UAV as-built models are acquired and ML semantic segmentation of point clouds updates bridge BIMs (crack/spalling detection). The domain is bridge/BIM infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A DeepLabV3-based model performs oil-spill detection in drone-acquired RGB imagery of ports (F1 0.9557, IoU 0.8643). The domain is oil-spill/environmental monitoring, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A GNSS-denied UAV navigation system uses a Cloud Teacher/Edge Student framework where a VLM generates ground-truth masks for terrain segmentation (U-Net/MobileNetV2), with satellite-derived labels. The domain is navigation and the modality uses satellite imagery, so EXC-01 and EXC-03 apply.
MPF performs 3D LiDAR point-cloud semantic segmentation on SemanticKITTI (mIoU 55.5). It is a LiDAR/autonomous-driving modality outside aerial agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-01 and EXC-03 apply.

A dual-view stereovision UAV inspection system with edge-assisted semantic segmentation monitors overhead transmission-line corridors. The domain is power-infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

CNN semantic segmentation plus GIS detects and maps urban green space from satellite/drone imagery (>90% accuracy). The domain is urban planning/environmental, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

RTSDM runs real-time semantic dense SLAM mapping on Jetson TX2 with BiSeNetV2 (~12 Hz, ~89% acc). Although INC-03 edge metrics are present, the domain is generic SLAM/mapping for rescue/inspection, not agricultural crop/weed, so EXC-03 applies.
SAM2/SAM2-UNet models segment shallow-water seagrass from drone/underwater imagery (IoU 0.923-0.935). The domain is marine/ecological, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

GeoTransNet uses ViT/SegFormer semantic segmentation and LiDAR for 3D terrain understanding/reconstruction from UAV data in engineering surveying (accuracy 97.31%). The domain is engineering surveying/terrain, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A spatiotemporal dual-branch attention method targets video semantic segmentation for autonomous driving, traffic management, and drone driving. The domain is driving/traffic, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

U-Net/SegNet/PSPNet semantically segment power lines in UAV multispectral images (~99% accuracy). The domain is power-infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Deep learning (PSPnet) extracts kiwifruit vine/canopy distribution from UAV images (IoU >=80%). Kiwifruit trellis vines are an orchard/vineyard (perennial fruit) domain, outside the crop/weed arable focus, so EXC-03 applies.

DeepLabV3-MobileNetV3 performs oil-spill semantic segmentation from high-resolution UAV harbor imagery (93.63% OA, oil F1 0.9485). The domain is oil-spill/marine, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

MAST combines morphological edge recognition with a Swin-Transformer to extract earthquake-triggered landslides from Luding UAV data. The domain is geological-hazard mapping, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A hybrid transformer-geometric SLAM framework (TinyViT multi-task) performs inverse depth/normals/semantic segmentation for industrial-scene UAV navigation (~1 FPS on Raspberry Pi 5). The domain is industrial SLAM/navigation, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

The task is cross-band generation of NIR/RE bands from RGB for cotton health monitoring using a transformer fusion model, with ExG vegetation segmentation only as non-deep preprocessing. A UAV deep-learning system on the AIDER dataset identifies disaster zones (floods/fires/collapses) and crowd presence for emergency response. The domain is disaster-response, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A hypernetwork real-time segmentation for low-altitude UAVs is validated on UAVid (66.3% mIoU, 37.9 FPS, buildings/roads/cars). The domain is urban UAV benchmark, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A 4D spatial-temporal digital-twin infrastructure uses voxel Spatial IDs and point-cloud semantic segmentation for city-scale digital twins and drone-route interference detection. The domain is digital-twin/urban informatics, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Semantic-aware path planning uses segmentation to navigate UAVs around textureless areas like lakes, oceans, and high-rise buildings. The domain is UAV navigation, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

MTMLNet+ performs infrared small-target detection/segmentation of aircraft, micro-UAVs, and weak heat sources on IRSTD-1k/SIRST-V2 (45.2 FPS). The domain is defence/maritime surveillance, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.
ENet road semantic segmentation is used for UAV pipeline displacement monitoring of oil-transport pipelines. The domain is pipeline-infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.
U-Net semantic segmentation plus A-star search recognizes power-line defects from UAV orthophotos (max accuracy 98.2%). The domain is power-infrastructure, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A fuzzy-inference landing-site-selection framework uses 3D point clouds and water-body semantic segmentation for autonomous UAV landing. The domain is UAV landing/safety, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

The work evaluates Linear Coding and Transmission for low-latency computer-vision offloading, measuring segmentation mIoU degradation under noisy channels. The domain is communication/compression, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

MSBE-Net is a multi-scale boundary-enhanced network for general terrain segmentation on UAVid/Potsdam/Vaihingen/LoveDA (71.3% mIoU, 85 FPS). These are generic urban/terrain benchmarks, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

E-Net lightweight segmentation is implemented on a Zynq 7035 FPGA for robots/UAVs/driverless applications (32.9 FPS). It is a generic edge-embedded segmentation accelerator without agricultural crop/weed content, so EXC-03 applies.

Floodet combines ponding prediction and flood semantic segmentation for road-flood detection on edge (NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX). The domain is flood/urban management, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A reliability/trustworthiness framework for drone swarms uses semantic segmentation for safe landing-area identification in urban surveillance and emergency response. The domain is drone operations/safety, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.
A DCNN with multiscale feature fusion segments remote-sensing imagery on ISPRS Potsdam and Urban Drone datasets. These are urban/land-cover benchmarks, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

The study derives optimal layer stackings/scheduling for depth-first memory-efficient UNet execution on dedicated FPGA/SoC hardware, using MFNet on multispectral drone images. A hybrid CNN+Swin-Transformer encoder-decoder segments general UAV remote-sensing imagery on UAVid and Aeroscapes urban land-cover benchmarks. These are generic urban/aerial datasets, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Faster R-CNN is used as a bounding-box object detector for flavescence doree grapevine disease (AP 82%), explicitly instead of pixel-wise segmentation. It is a bounding-box detection task (EXC-02) in a grapevine/orchard domain (EXC-03).

Fluid-SegFormer is a lightweight SegFormer-based model for terrestrial oil-spill segmentation from UAV imagery (mIoU 87.84%). The domain is oil-spill/energy, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Time-to-collision estimation for maritime vessels uses aerial drone semantic segmentation of objects (mean error 0.358s). The domain is maritime navigation, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

EMFNet is a transformer + multiscale network for UAV marine-environment segmentation (Cityscapes 77.13%, UAV-OUC-SEG 61.41%, 61.6 FPS). The domain is marine/evironmental, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

A drone traffic-surveillance framework uses PSPNet segmentation plus DeepSORT/optical flow/Kalman on AU-AIR and Aerial Car datasets (97% detection, 93% tracking). The domain is urban traffic, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.

Frontier-guided area coverage by small UAVs uses monocular depth estimation and reinforcement learning, explicitly operating without semantic segmentation. The domain is UAV navigation/coverage, not crop/weed agronomy, so EXC-03 applies.
